provenance.client: KakaoTalk for Mac 26.8.0 field model; mooo diagnostic extraction rules
provenance.method: Every body mirrors one recorded in research/web-error-bodies.md: an unauthenticated response observed in WEB-LIVE-001 (observed-unauthenticated.json, with message text replaced by synthetic text of the same language and shape), the body reported in frrad/mooo#424 (WEB-REP-001), or a katalk body shape traced from the Mac client in WEB-BIN-001 (static-mac-error-model.json). No case is invented to stress a parser. safe_to_log follows that document's extraction rules, which are a mooo implementation decision: the official client logs nothing from these bodies and has no equivalent function.

rules: Extract only from a body that is exactly one UTF-8 JSON object with no duplicate keys at any depth and no trailing data. Otherwise extract nothing.
status: a JSON integer literal (no fraction or exponent) from -9999999 to 9999999.
reason: a string matching ^[A-Z][A-Z_]{0,63}$ after JSON unescaping.
reason.detailCode: when reason is an object, its detailCode under the status rule. Nothing else is read from the object.
code: a string matching ^[0-9]{1,7}$, or a JSON integer under the status rule. A string stays a string.
Only top-level status, reason, code and reason.detailCode are ever extracted. Every other field, nested object or rejected value is dropped.
A field absent from safe_to_log must be absent from the diagnostic, not rendered as an empty value or the literal text null.
